verdict.rationale: Exposing a vault through a local programmatic endpoint is a fair question for an authenticator or secrets app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only in-app UI actions, Google Account sync and QR-code transfer between devices, with no local API, CLI or endpoint an agent could query. The PAM module and the OTP generator implementations are server-side or developer building blocks, not a way to expose the user's vault, and community posts say even a plain text export is difficult.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app
